post.title: Your Mind Is Somewhere Else Half the Day #shorts
post.description: Where did your mind go just now? Tell me in the comments. Send this to the friend who's never fully here. Sam's in the shower and his mind is already at tomorrow's meeting. In 'A Wandering Mind Is an Unhappy Mind' (Science, 2010), Matthew Killingsworth and Daniel Gilbert of Harvard used an iPhone app to ping 2,250 adults at random moments and ask what they were doing, what they were thinking about and how happy they felt. People's minds were wandering in 46.9% of the samples, and people were less happy when their minds wandered than when they didn't. Even when they drifted to pleasant topics, they were no happier than when focused on what they were doing, and what people were thinking predicted their happiness better than what they were doing. Small fix: notice one real thing in front of you. #psychology #shorts #mindwandering #overthinking #mindfulness
